campaign: Website hero background - dark premium workspace

scenes.prompt:
A silent 8 second website hero background video, 16:9, 1080p, 24fps.

Palette. Warm amber and copper accent tones on a near-black ambient ground. The overriding tonal relationship across this shot is warm amber light against near-black shadow. All warm surfaces carry a consistent amber-to-ochre warmth. No cold tones. No blue shadows. No grey or green drift in any lit surface.

Absence. No readable text on any surface in frame. No logos or brand marks. No identifiable faces. No reflections of people in any window, screen, or polished surface. No other people in frame, no background figures, no silhouettes.

A minimal dark modern desk surface in a near-black contemporary interior. The scene is sparse, precise and uncluttered. Only two physical objects are visible: the cropped edge of a premium unbranded closed laptop on the right side of the frame, and a simple clear rectangular glass prism or narrow ribbed glass panel standing near the far-right edge of the desk. The glass object is understated and architectural, like a clean optical block, not a lamp, not a sculpture, not a decorative ornament.

A warm copper-gold light source from off frame passes through the simple glass prism, creating real physical refraction: clean copper bands, soft caustic streaks and subtle warm highlights moving slowly across the dark desk surface. The refracted light gently grazes the laptop edge and reveals the first hint of a modern digital workspace emerging from darkness. The light must feel physically shaped by glass, not like a flat gradient or abstract overlay.

The composition is built for a website hero. The glass prism and laptop edge sit centre-right and upper-right. The left 45 percent of the frame remains deep, quiet and visually calm for later website copy. The lower-left quadrant remains especially dark and empty. The bottom third of the frame falls toward solid near-black before the lower edge.

Camera is locked off with a disciplined 35mm equivalent lens feel. No camera shake, no handheld movement, no zoom. Motion is extremely restrained: only the slow drift of copper-gold refracted light across the dark surface. The mood is calm, premium, modern and controlled. The shot communicates clarity, order and attention beginning to emerge through light.
